sloka: कार्यसिद्धिर्मतिश्चैव तस्मिन् वानरपुङ्गवे ।व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च श्रुतं चापि प्रतिष्ठितम् ।। ५.६३.१९ ।।।।
transliteration: kāryasiddhirmatiścaiva tasmin vānarapuṅgave ।vyavasāyaśca vīryaṁ ca śrutaṁ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam ।। 5.63.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Where Jambavan, Angada and Hanuman are leaders directing the task of the army it must have been accomplished.
